notes.resolution_families: Resolution and Pleno families remain review-required in v1 because the observed 2023-2025 corpus contains too few examples to justify automatic-promotion certification.
notes.docket_numbers: Dockets are measured by the evaluator but are not an automatic-promotion gate in v1 until normalization semantics are further reviewed.
notes.parser_predictions: Parser values in the review queue are reviewer hints only and must not be copied into gold without checking primary-source pages.
